title: The primary colour reads at WCAG AA as a button fill and as text on white
steps: S1: read --primary and --primary-foreground from tokens.css and from page-shell.js and compute both contrast ratios.
expect: S1: a label on the primary and the primary on white are each at least 4.5:1 in both files.
evidence: Issue #228: #fafafa on #bf5b3d read 4.21:1 on every primary button

tests: tokens.css: a label on the primary colour and the primary colour on white both read at AA (#228)
page-shell.js: a label on the primary colour and the primary colour on white both read at AA (#228)
page-shell.js redeclares the same primary as tokens.css
